retrievalProfile.description: A tight, warm-toned male portrait with decorative swash typography clustered in the upper right corner, characteristic of 1970s soul and pop album covers.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly low-angle portrait of a man with dark, textured hair, set against a soft-focus warm background. The composition is anchored by the subject's face on the left and a block of decorative, right-aligned typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed upward and away from the text
Typography nested within the negative space of the background
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool blue clothing and eyes
Textured hair framing the top of the composition
coreInvariants: Decorative swash terminals on display typography
Tight facial cropping cutting off the top of the hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, which are positioned at the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his upward gaze toward the top right, landing on the decorative text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus brown and tan background in the upper right provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and earthy browns in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue in the clothing and iris of the eyes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and light cyan for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with a high-value, warm mid-tone range typical of vintage film.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors

letterConstructionRules: Extravagant curly swashes on capital letters and descenders
Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital S and B featuring large, circular loops
Lowercase y and g with elongated, curling descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine large decorative swash serifs with smaller, simpler sans-serif or slab-serif sub-text in a contrasting color.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative serif look with curly terminals.
Provides the high-contrast, elegant display feel required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with 70s-style textured hair, warm skin tones, and blue eyes, looking slightly upward. The background should be a soft-focus, warm tan color with plenty of space in the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the upper right corner using a white decorative swash serif font. Include a smaller line of text in light cyan for contrast.

verificationChecks: Do the capital letters have decorative swashes?
Is the portrait cropped tightly at the top?
Is the color palette warm and vintage-inspired?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
postGenerationChecks: Check that typography does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the swashes are smooth and not jagged
Verify the right-alignment of the text block
Confirm the warm, vintage color balance
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a tight, soulful portrait with right-aligned, decorative swash typography in the negative space for a classic 70s album aesthetic.
